title: Veera Thalattu
desc: Pandi, a villager, loves his mother beyond words. However, Pandi gets shocked when his uncle reveals that she is not the one who gave birth to him.

title: Azhahi
desc: Shanmugam, a vet, is happily married to Valarmati and has two children. However, things take a turn, when Shanmugam's childhood love enters his life.

title: Manasellam
desc: Bala manages to find a place to stay after losing his bag with all his belongings. However, his roommates concoct a vicious plan and get him beaten to ruin his chances with their cute neighbour.

title: Mundhanai Mudichu
desc: Parimalam, a mischievous girl, falls in love with a widower who works as a teacher. She marries him by falsely accusing him of molesting her, but she has to take a drastic step to win his heart.
